div.head: Design
div.p: A pot experiment tested rice in saline soil. Three pots received flooded irrigation.

div.head: Sampling
div.p: Soil nitrogen was measured after harvest using spectrophotometry.

div.head: Yield
div.p: Grain yield increased by 12%. No significant nitrogen difference was found.

div.head: Discussion
div.p: Yield was associated with soil nitrogen. A single season limits generalization.
